assisted by Mr. Mohd. Matlub, learned counsel for 
the petitioner. 
2. Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, learned Brief Holder 
for the State. 
3. Learned counsel for the State submits that 
both the respondents have been changed and new 
incumbents have been appointed in their place; 
therefore, the petitioner may file an appropriate 
impleadment application.
4. On this, learned Senior Counsel prays for and 
is granted a week’s time to file the impleadment 
application.
5. Learned counsel for the State is directed to 
supply the names and designations of the new 
incumbents to the learned counsel for the petitioner.
6. List on 14.05.2026.
